notes: Three corrections. The with of clothe thee with them all and the with of gird thyself with them are supplied for the English verb to reach the Hebrew's bare direct object and belong to their verbs under rule 44, as they do at 49.10, 49.13, 49.15, 49.23 and 49.25. And the comparative kaf takes as with whole, as it does at 49.26, rather than as alone with the second word left on the noun.
